name: qsm-usage
description: Reviews how you use Claude Code and proposes what to cut, what to make permanent, and what to reach for instead, each with its saving in tokens; ships the measuring tools it stands on: qsm-usage count and toon, and a hook that filters shell output before the agent reads it.

toonWrap.title: TOON wrap list
toonWrap.description: Tool calls whose structured output reaches the model as TOON when that is smaller. A Bash pattern matches the command, an mcp__ pattern the tool name; * matches anything.
